assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production raster UI button sprite for a tactile fantasy desktop game interface, not a mockup. Restrained late medieval craftsmanship. Readable silhouette at small sizes, broad simple end fittings with one engraved leaf incision, not lace or tiny filigree. Face is rich nearly black brown walnut with fine subtle horizontal grain. Brass border is a real thick inlaid metal band, worn golden top ridge and dark recessed joints, integral to the wood. The button is about 6.5 times as wide as tall and fills almost the full image width, with only a small transparent safety margin. Wide landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 384. Show exactly one button, no sample sheet, no background, no floor, no surrounding objects. Crisp art suited to native Godot nine-patch resizing; straight parallel middle upper and lower rails, all sculpted silhouette detail at the ends.
